test_title: PYST 26: SSC MTS - Reasoning (Held on: 2 Oct 2021 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as the numbers of the following set.

(12, 30, 204)
solution:
The pattern followed here is:

(12, 30, 204): 12² + 30 × 2 = 144 + 60 = 204.

Similarly, (15, 20, 265): 152 + 20 × 2 = 225 + 40 = 265.

Hence, (15, 20, 265) is the correct answer.
